notes: v53 = P0 fix -- a managed/interface inline var declared inside a nested begin..end (IHolder<T>) is now released at THAT BLOCK'S END instead of in the procedure epilogue. Compiler-binary-only refresh on top of v52; no PPU format, RTL or package change. UNITS ARE UNCHANGED FROM v52 -- pair this bin with the existing vibepascal-v52-win64-units.tar.gz; an existing v52 units install stays valid and does NOT need re-pulling, so auto-update.bat can take the ~3.4 MB bin alone. tgeneric133 PASSes exit 0 under both -Mdelphiunicode and -Munleashed. Blocks containing goto/label deliberately keep the old proc-exit finalization (never a leak, never a double-free). Known pre-existing gap, same on v52 and v53: an inline var in the MAIN PROGRAM BODY is a staticvarsym and is still not block-released.
